To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the corrosion resistance of 430 stainless steels is improved by annealing.

the microstructure characteristics and its effects on corrosion of 430 stainless Steel plate are as follows: (1) The hot-rolled 0.5 mm thick 430 stainless steel has obvious layered corrosion phenomenon in 6%FeCI3 and 10%HC1, but uniformity corrosion in annealing plate.
the corrosion resistance of 430 stainless steels is improved by hot rolling deformation, and the corrosion resistance of the annealed 430 stainless steel is the best.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the microstructure and corrosion of 430 stainless steels under the different deformation conditions.
the influence of the band on the corrosion characteristics and microstructure of 430 stainless plate.
the influence of hot-rolled and heat treatment on the microstructure of the stainless steel 430,and the influence of microstructure on corrosion behavior.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the hot rolled plate of 430 stainless steels has better corrosion resistance than the annealing plate.
the microstructure characteristics and corrosion of 430 stainless plate is closely related to its production process and corrosion environment.
the microstructure of the hot-rolled plate and the annealed plate is the main factor that affects the intercrystal and intergranular corrosion of 430 ferrite steel.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the corrosion of hot-rolled plate in the acid medium is more severe than that of annealed plate,which is related to the distribution of carbon and the microstructure of the steel.
the microstructure of hot-rolled steel plate has great influence on the inter-crystal corrosion characteristics of the steel plate.
the corrosion resistance of hot-rolled plate is better than that of annealing plate in the media of H2SO4 and FeCl3,and that of annealing steel is better than that hot-rolled in the media of KSCN.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the corrosion of the hot-rolled 0.5mol/L H2SO 4 + 0. 01mol/L KSCN is the main reason that the corrosion of hot-rolled plate is worse than that of annealed plate,which is mainly due to the band of carbide.
the microstructural band of carbon particles in 430 ferritic stainless steel is the main cause of intergranular fracture and inter-crystal corrosion.

the corrosion behavior of the 430 ferrite grade stainless steel is related to the microstructure of the steel, and it is not only affected by the composition of the medium, but also by the processing conditions.
